payload.title: Exact-Claim consumed before calculation: below-threshold illustrative ray stiffness candidate

proposal.method: Before each numerical run fetch exact Claim via official MCP, verify Record digest/ref, parse EI_crit rational from statement, verify original result/request scope, multiply parsed value by case margin to construct actual solver EI. No hardcoded fallback stiffness. Reuse installed beam adapter.
controls: Wrong uniform-law L^3 mutant rejected by quadrature control
Missing/altered Claim ref or source context fails before solve
Mutating parsed critical value changes derived candidate EI; full scope gate rejects inconsistency

payload.cost_stop_bounds: One CPU/thread,4GiB,128tasks,600s whole process; no cloud/GPU/network solver. Stop on pin mismatch or numerical-control failure; invalid candidate remains visible.
acceptance_criteria: Exact source Claim and historical request pins verified before compute
Fixed quadrature/null/mutant/FEM controls pass or failures retained
Actual derived stiffness and invalid/valid model-domain outcome preserved
Output hashes and exact Action producer recorded; independent review required
